title: Digital Distribution of Government's Tourism Vouchers to Singaporeans including the Elderly and Extension of Use of Vouchers to Arts-related Activities
what_it_is: Digital Distribution of Government's Tourism Vouchers to Singaporeans including the Elderly and Extension of Use of Vouchers to Arts-related Activities

sections.label: Voucher redemption dates and SingPass
sections.summary: Vouchers can be redeemed from 1 December 2020 until end-June 2021, and Singapore Citizens redeem them via SingPass.

sentences.speaker: Mr Alvin Tan
sentences.text: The vouchers will be available for redemption from 1 December 2020 and will be valid until end-June 2021.

sentences.speaker: Mr Alvin Tan
sentences.text: Singapore Citizens will be able to redeem the vouchers via SingPass.

sections.label: Booking platforms offer touchpoints
sections.summary: Klook Travel Technology with UOB Travel Planners, Changi Travel Services and GlobalTix will offer digital and physical touchpoints for the SRVs.

sentences.speaker: Mr Alvin Tan
sentences.text: Klook Travel Technology with UOB Travel Planners, Changi Travel Services and GlobalTix, which are booking platforms for the SRVs, will offer both digital and physical touchpoints.

sections.label: Sector qualifies for JSS Tier 2
sections.summary: Entities under this sector qualify for Jobs Support Scheme Tier 2 support until March 2021.

sentences.speaker: Mr Alvin Tan
sentences.text: In fact, entities under this sector qualifies for the Jobs Support Scheme, JSS, Tier 2 support till March 2021.

sections.label: STB help for seniors
sections.summary: STB will explore working with social service organisations and the PA to help seniors use vouchers, such as by organising small group tours.

sentences.speaker: Mr Alvin Tan
sentences.text: Specific to the Member's point, to help seniors who are staying alone or have little social support to use their vouchers, STB will explore working with social service organisations and the PA to facilitate of the usage of the vouchers such as by organising small group tours for seniors where permissible.

sections.label: Attraction capacity and voucher period
sections.summary: Capacity at tourist attractions has been increased to 50% for now, and the vouchers are meant to run from December to June.

sentences.speaker: Mr Alvin Tan
sentences.text: The second one first, with regard to the capacity at our tourist attractions, we have increased it to 50% for now.

sentences.speaker: Mr Alvin Tan
sentences.text: So, we will look into how the COVID-19 situation is being managed.

sentences.speaker: Mr Alvin Tan
sentences.text: Also, with regard to the spread of the vouchers, it is meant to be from December all the way up to June.

sections.label: Physical touchpoints for redemption
sections.summary: STB is working with PA for about 40 community centres with SingPass counters and up to 66 physical touchpoints to assist Singapore Citizens.

sentences.speaker: Mr Alvin Tan
sentences.text: With regard to the physical touchpoints, currently, STB is working with PA for about 40 community centres or CCs with SingPass counters, and up to 66 physical touchpoints, set up by the appointed booking platforms that I mentioned, or near the CCs to assist the Singapore Citizens to redeem their vouchers.
